# Penpot (`penpot-penpot`)

Revolutionize your design workflow with Penpot, the open-source tool where design meets code. Create stunning designs, prototypes, and integrate seamlessly with developers. Collaborate effortlessly!

[Source](https://github.com/penpot/penpot)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "penpot-penpot"
  name       = "mypenpot"

  parameters = {
    DbUrl      = "..."
    DbUsername = "..."
    RedisUrl   = "..."
    # DbPassword = "..."
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DbUrl` | string | yes | Database connection URI for Penpot's PostgreSQL database. This is the primary database where all application data including projects, files, users, and teams are stored. |
| `DbUsername` | string | yes | Username for authenticating with the PostgreSQL database specified in the database URI. |
| `DbPassword` | string | no | Password for the database user specified in DbUsername. Used for PostgreSQL authentication. |
| `RedisUrl` | string | yes | Redis connection URI for Penpot's caching and session management. Redis is used for real-time collaboration features, caching, and temporary data storage. |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
